svg.title: cooking_machine
svg.desc: A 10-frame SVG flipbook of a red industrial conveyor oven. The frames are controlled by joystick spin speed through the embedded JavaScript API.
svg.metadata: cooking_machine flipbook Size: 750x250 Frames: 10 API examples: - element.contentDocument.defaultView.CookingMachine.setSpinSpeed(value) - element.contentDocument.defaultView.CookingMachine.setJoystickRPM(rpm) - element.contentDocument.defaultView.CookingMachine.applySpin(rotations) - window.postMessage({type:'cooking-machine:setSpinSpeed', speed:0.5}, '*')
